resources.string: Reads the caller name shown by Truecaller during an incoming call, for SpamBlok\'s own caller-ID database. This build only logs locally — it stores and sends nothing.

Phase 1 — Banner reader test

Goal: confirm we can read the caller name off Truecaller's incoming (ringing) screen as text.

Steps:
1. Tap the button below and enable "SpamBlok Banner Reader".
2. Make sure Truecaller is installed and its caller ID is ON.
3. Call this phone from another number and let it ring.
4. On a computer, run:
 adb logcat -s SpamBlokA11y
 and watch for the caller name to appear.

This build only logs locally. It does not store or send anything.
